bagPolicy.summary: Leave bags at home if you can. Any purse or bag you bring is searched before entry. Pocket knives, pepper spray, flasks and outside food and drinks aren't allowed.
bagPolicy.quote: We would prefer that you leave bags at home, but if you must bring your bag, it will be searched

parking.summary: The Atlantis parking lot is at 2366 9th St NW, a few blocks north of the venue. The monitored lot opens 1 hour before doors, and you can buy parking online or on site if spaces remain.
parking.quote: The Atlantis parking lot is located at 2366 9th St NW, a few blocks north of the venue.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Atlantis. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Atlantis doesn't serve food, and outside food and drink aren't allowed. The bars serve beer, wine, liquor and non-alcoholic drinks, and they take major credit and debit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
concessions.quote: We do not serve food in the venue and we do not permit any outside food or drink into the venue.

accessibility.summary: Staff can help with accessibility needs, including seating and ASL interpreters. Call the box office at 202-579-9950 to request accommodations. Request ASL interpreters at least 2 weeks before the show.
accessibility.quote: To best way to request accommodations is to call our box office at 202-579-9950.

reEntry.summary: The Atlantis hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy advance tickets on Ticketmaster or in person at the 9:30 Club box office. Tickets are non-transferable until 72 hours before showtime. Shows are all ages unless posted, and you need a physical ID to buy alcohol.
ticketPickup.quote: Unless otherwise posted, The Atlantis is all ages, all the time.

gates.summary: The Atlantis sits just behind 9:30 Club at 2047 9th St NW. Arrive before doors open, and bags are searched at entry. The rooftop and rooftop bar open to ticket holders once general admission doors open.
gates.quote: The rooftop and rooftop bar is open to ticket holders once general admission doors open.
